_comment: Key overrides for modulating charts. Each entry: base key, plus ordered changes — from source line N (1-based, the section header line) onward the key is Y. Section names repeat across keys in some charts (if-i-didnt-have-you reuses [MIKE]/[SULLEY]), so mapping is by line, not name. Verified against each chart's section headers on 2026-07-18. our-love-is-here-to-stay has no 'Key:' label in metadata — base key supplied here from its 'Transposed to D major' note.
